dedupe_keys.name: trace des routes secondaires d occitanie

description: Tracé des routes secondaires d'Occitanie is a dataset listed in Occitanie open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Occitanie. Cette couche géographique représente les liaisons routières régionales de la région Occitanie. Elle a été générée à partir de la base ROUTE 500®. Coverage: Occitanie. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are route, secondaire, occitanie. The portal shows 19,936 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2017-08-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-laregion-fr-portal.
